title: 42 perfect gift ideas for your favourite cyclist this Christmas
content:
Cyclist
42 perfect gift ideas for your favourite cyclist this Christmas

4iiii PRECISION 3+ power meter

Easy and precise power measurement.

Buy it now from uk.4iiii.com or read more.

Hunt 40 Carbon Disc wheels

One of the most impactful changes you can make to your bike.

Buy it now from huntbikewheels.com or read more.

AMPP 2200 front bike light

Powerful illumination that lets you see and be seen no matter how dark it is.

Buy it now from cateyecycling.co.uk or read more.

BAZ & CO Body Gift Set

A body wash and deodorant combo with basil, witch hazel and vetiver.

Buy it now from bazandcoskincare.com or read more.

Selle Italia SLR Endurance Elite saddle

Keep sitting comfortably on Selle Italia’s well-padded yet lightweight SLR Endurance Elite.

Buy it now from selleitalia.com or read more.

Bioracer Christmas Socks three-pack

A festive trio of funky footwear to warm up your winter rides.

Buy it now from bioracer.com or read more.

Condor Essentials Cold Weather Overshoes

Keep your feet warm and dry with these clever, 3D cut overshoes.

Buy it now from condorcycles.com or read more.

Buxumbox Ventoux bike box

A top-quality bike box that gives your bike a first class travel upgrade.

Buy it now from buxumbox.com or read more.

Daysaver All-You-Need value combo

Save the day with Daysaver’s modular multitool/mini-pump combo.

Buy it now from daysaver.fun or read more.

Pearson On&On Adventure gravel bike

The adventure goes on and on with this well made gravel bike from UK bike maker Pearson.

Buy it now from pearsoncycles.com or read more.

Van Rysel HT RCR with Zwift Cog and Click

Indoor trainers don’t get more versatile than the HT RCR.

Buy it now from decathlon.co.uk or read more.

Garmin Edge 1060 GPS cycling computer

Garmin’s all-singing Edge 1060 is all the bike computer you’ll ever need.

Buy it now from sigmasports.com or read more.

Leatt Flat 3.0 SuperTack shoes

Form and function combine with Leatt’s phenomenally grippy flat pedal shoes.

Buy it now from leatt.com (from mid-November) or read more.

Scott Road RC Ultimate shoes

The ultimate road shoe for all-day riding performance.

Buy it now from scott-sports.com or read more.

G8 Performance Pro Series 2620 orthotic insoles

In-shoe support for your feet that’s thin, light and customisable.

Buy it now from g8performance.com or read more.

Trek Air Rush Electric Pump

Say goodbye to CO2 cannisters with this compact yet powerful electric pump.

Buy it now from trekbikes.com or read more.

Garmin Rally RS210 dual-sided power meter pedals

Power meter pedals that don’t make you choose between road and gravel.

Buy it now from sigmasports.com or read more.

Rule 28 OTNR long-sleeve aero jersey

An aero winter jersey that will keep you warm while moving fast on colder rides.

Buy it now from rule28.com or read more.

The Model Cyclist 

Recreate the cyclist in your life – or even yourself – in miniature.

Buy it now from themodelcyclist.com or read more.

Inferno Series

Multi-stage riding challenges across Europe that let you ride like the pros.

Buy it now from infernoseries.com or read more.

Rocker Feet for turbos

An easy and affordable way to dial up the comfort on your indoor trainer.

Buy it now from therockerfeetco.com or read more.

Bryton Rider S810 bike computer

A feature-rich bike computer with all the battery life you could ever need.

Buy it now from extrauk.co.uk or read more.

Trek RSL Road Cycling shoes

Stiff yet supple, efficient yet comfortable, the Trek RSLs have a lot going for them.

Buy it now from trekbikes.com or read more.

Moon Sport Metis light

A bike light with a computer mount with a powerful 1,000 lumen output.

Buy it now from extrauk.co.uk or read more.

Ravemen FR1500 front light

More power, more battery life… there’s no excuse not to get out riding this winter.

Buy it now from ravemen.com or read more.

Ravemen FR1000 front light

A smart and capable front light with plenty of clever features.

Buy it now from ravemen.com or read more.

Pactimo Men’s Alpine thermal bibtights

Soft and fleecy bibtights for rides on the coldest of days.

Buy it now from pactimo.com or read more.

Ravemen CL200 Bike Tail Light

Clean, streamlined and lightweight, with an impressively wide-angle beam.

Buy it now from ravemen.com or read more.

Veto 1.0 Crew socks

Simple, affordable and comfortable yet packing wind-tunnel-tested aero credentials.

Buy it now from vetosocks.com or read more.

Madison Flux HydroShift jacket

Lightweight and comfortable, protective cycling kit doesn’t get better than this.

Buy it now from madison.cc or read more.

Wattbike Atom indoor smart bike

The ideal way to get your cycling new year off to the perfect start.

Buy it now from wattbike.com or read more.

Scott Blade sunglasses

Optimal field of vision from a sleek, semi-frameless design.

Buy it now from scott-sports.com or read more.

Liv Tesca Pro gravel shoes

Protective, pro-performance shoes designed specifically for women.

Buy it now from liv-cycling.com or read more.

Giant Surge Pro cycling shoes

Capable, ultra-stiff shoes designed to cope with the rigours of WorldTour racing.

Buy it now from giant-bicycles.com or read more.

4Endurance 2:1 Bundle

An endurance triple-play to cover every nutrition need on the bike.

Buy it now from 4endurance.co.uk or read more.

Marmot Tours gift voucher

Got enough cycling stuff? How about a gift voucher for a cycling holiday instead?

Buy it now from marmot-tours.co.uk or read more.

L’Étape Cycliste Signature Urban cycling shorts

Enjoy on-bike riding comfort without looking like you’re dressed for a race.

Buy it now from letapecycliste.com or read more.

Gtechniq maintenance kits

Everything you need to give your bike a full clean.

Buy it now from gtechniq.co.uk or read more.

Garmin Forerunner 970 GPS watch

Wrist-based navigation with just about every feature you could ask for.

Buy it now from sigmasports.com or read more.

Condor Essentials Toe Covers

Keep your toes toasty and your shoes clean on cold-weather rides.

Buy it now from condorcycles.com or read more.

Apidura Packable Musette

A super-light musette that’s roomy inside and packed with clever features.

Buy it now from apidura.com or read more.

A Cyclist gift subscription

£87.95 | cyclist.co.uk

Need the perfect gift for the hard-to-buy-for cyclist in your life? The answer is a subscription to the world’s finest cycling magazine. Cyclist is the multi-award winning magazine that’s packed with beautiful rides, inspiring stories and all the coolest bikes and kit. A Cyclist gift subscription includes a handsome presentation box, a free extra copy of Cyclist magazine, a Cyclist tote bag, a summit sign sticker, a welcome letter from the editor and, of course, a year’s subscription to Cyclist magazine, delivered to their door over the coming year.

4iiii PRECISION 3+ power meter

From £349.99 | uk.4iiii.com

As the saying goes, what gets measured gets improved, so in cycling performance terms there’s little more valuable than tracking power output. 4iiii’s PRECISION 3+ power meter makes that easy to do. It’s a lightweight pod that comes attached to a range of Shimano non-driveside crank arms (six models, all in various lengths), so all the rider needs to do is swap it over for the original and they’re off. The PRECISION 3+ tracks power to ±1% accuracy, can determine the terrain being riden and boasts an industry-leading 800-hour battery life. Its ace card, however, is that it’s equipped with Apple’s Find My GPS tech, meaning your bike’s location can be tracked easily.

Hunt 40 Carbon Disc wheels

£879 | huntbikewheels.com

Upgrading wheels is among the most impactful changes you can make to your bike. The 22mm internal width of Hunt’s 40 Carbon Discs pairs neatly with popular 28-32mm tyre sizes, while their 40mm depth adds aero performance without sacrificing weight (this set is just 1,433g). The rims are made primarily of Toray’s lightweight T700 carbon, the Pillar PSR triple butted J-bend spokes are easy to source for replacements, and the durable H_Ratchet 36T SGL hubs are easily serviced.

AMPP 2200 front bike light

£179.99 | cateyecycling.co.uk

When it comes to front lights, all too often you have to choose between ‘see’ or ‘be seen’. With Cateye’s AMPP 2200, however, you get both. For dark nights on quiet roads or off-road trails, the super-bright 2,200-lumen Ultra Boost mode is enough to light up the path ahead, while the Daytime HyperConstant mode makes you more visible in daylight. In flashing mode the battery will last 60 hours between charges, and the whole thing comes in a tidy package that weighs an impressively lightweight 213.5g.

BAZ & CO Body Gift Set

£38 | bazandcoskincare.com

The BAZ Body Gift Set pairs two staples in a canvas wash bag: the Restore & Awaken Body Wash, scented with basil, grapefruit and spearmint, and the Naturally Fresh Deodorant, with basil, witch hazel and vetiver. BAZ & CO is a British skincare brand that grows its own basil on vertical farms and blends its products in the UK. The body wash comes in a 250ml pump bottle, the deodorant a 50ml spray. For anyone who rides, the set covers the post-ride shower and the morning after, with a wash bag ready for the car or a weekend away.

Selle Italia SLR Endurance Elite saddle

£174.99 | selleitalia.com

Are you sitting comfortably? You will be if you’re sitting on the Selle Italia SLR Endurance saddle post-Christmas. That’s because the saddle’s padding has been bolstered to allow more freedom of movement, while built-in gel inserts boost comfort. A wider tip adds stability and support on climbs, and shock absorbers soak up road vibrations. That’s on top of the build quality that has kept Selle Italia at the forefront of the saddle market for nearly 130 years.

Bioracer Christmas Socks three-pack

£25 | bioracer.com

Socks are time-honoured stocking fillers, so what better than Christmas-themed cycling socks? Bioracer has this three-pack, which includes a trio of Yuletide-themed designs that will keep your feet warm, dry and comfortable when logging those winter miles. The Belgian brand knows a thing or two about cold weather kit, so these festive designs are perfect for your freezing rides. Socks are for life, but also for Christmas.

Condor Essentials Cold Weather Overshoes

£34.99 | condorcycles.com

Our kingdom for a warm, dry pair of winter overshoes that don’t fall apart in a season. And Condor might just have done it. Made from 3D cut neoprene to flex and move with the ankle, these overshoes feature a hydrophobic coating, taped seams and storm zippers for warmth and waterproofing, with longevity increased by reinforced, abrasion-resistant bumpers and edges around the toe, heel, arch and cleat. They’re rounded off with reflective detailing and silicone grippers.

Buxumbox Ventoux bike box

£1,176 | buxumbox.com

Taking a bike on holiday can be a struggle, but if you’ve spent good money on a top-spec bike, why would you want to hire one when riding abroad? Buxumbox’s Ventoux bike box is designed for bikes with integrated cockpits, so you don’t have to remove the bars to fit it in; all that needs removing are the wheels and seatpost. It’s handmade in the UK from aerospace-grade aluminium, has four wheels for easy movement plus mounting brackets that mean foam and padding isn’t needed. 

Daysaver All-You-Need value combo

€129.95 (approx £110) | daysaver.fun

The All-You-Need Gravel/Road Value Combination comprises Daysaver’s Pump 30 PO pump, Incredible6 multitool and multi-position frame mount. The stainless steel Incredible6 includes a pair of tyre levers, a T-handle tubeless tool and hex 6 and hex 8 tools, but the really clever part is that it slots into the Pump 30 PO itself to give you a full suite of maintenance tools in a neat package that clips into the frame mount. Plus the system is modular so you can mix and match with Daysaver’s other tools. Consider the day saved.

Pearson On&On Adventure gravel bike

From £2,600 (frameset) | pearsoncycles.com

Pearson has been around since 1860, yet its latest bikes are decidedly forward-thinking, including this, the On&On Adventure gravel bike. The aero-optimised frameset is built using high-strength T700 carbon with off-road-friendly geometry for stability on broken surfaces. There’s clearance for up to 45mm tyres and an array of mounting points for adding mudguards and luggage carriers, though the frameset looks so good on its own you may be tempted not to. Complete builds are available with Shimano’s GRX groupset.

Van Rysel HT RCR with Zwift Cog and Click

£749.99 | decathlon.co.uk

Whether you want targeted interval training or high-watt online racing, Van Rysels’s HT RCR is about as versatile as indoor trainers get. Its self powered mode means it can function away from a power source, or it can be plugged in and connected to an ethernet cable to give accurate race readings. It offers ±1% power accuracy, downhill simulation and gradient simulations of up to 27%, as well as wireless connectivity. It comes fitted with a Zwift Cog too, which simulates realistic gear changes without shifting the chain.

Garmin Edge 1060 GPS cycling computer

£699 | sigmasports.com

This is it, the best of the best cycling computers – a machine that crams a huge amount into its slim, elegant package. It has a bright, clear 3.5-inch colour touchscreen and 60-hour battery life in low-power mode (or still 20 hours in most demanding usage). There’s all the mapping you could need and metrics you could want, plus hazard alerts, group ride connectivity, a built-in speaker, smart training plans, road surface displays and much more. You can even buy your groceries with it. 

Leatt Flat 3.0 SuperTack shoes

£129.99 | leatt.com (available from mid-November)

Flat-pedal shoes need to hit the right blend of form and function, and the Flat 3.0 SuperTack nails the brief. The low-profile silhouette is easy on the eye, while a recycled Cordura upper and compression laces make for a sock-like fit. The star of the show, however, is the SuperTack rubber compound and sole pattern, which delivers phenomenal grip for fantastic pedal traction and bike control. The quick-drying, antibacterial insole and anti-slip heel construction are designed to provide all-day comfort, both on and off the bike. 

Scott Road RC Ultimate shoes

£349.99 | scott-sports.com

The Scott Road RC Ultimate is a top-of-the-line shoe built for race-day performance. Its carbon sole rates 10 on Scott’s stiffness index and combines with the lightweight PU upper to maximise power transfer without compromising fit. The shoe delivers micro-adjustable precision through the Boa dials, lightweight laces and low-friction lace guides, and an adjustable ErgoLogic insole features an interchangeable arch and metatarsal inserts for personalised support. Despite all this, the Road RC Ultimate weighs just 245g. 

G8 Performance Pro Series 2620 orthotic insoles

£110 | g8performance.com

The Pro Series 2620 insoles are thin, light and customisable, meaning the four size options can be cut down to the shape of your specific shoe before adding the relevant supports depending on the height of your arches. The 2620 insoles enable the rider’s feet to be activated, rather than remaining totally rigid, which G8 claims improves forefoot flex, bloodflow and power transfer. With continued use, they can strengthen a rider’s feet and help alleviate injuries too.

Trek Air Rush Electric Pump

£69.99 | trekbikes.com

‘The CO₂ canister is dead, and we have killed it.’ Thus didn’t spoke Zarathustra, but it’s still true, because with an electric pump like Trek’s Air Rush, why would you ever carry single-use cartridges again? Little bigger than a matchbox, the Air Rush holds a charge equivalent to four CO₂ canisters, can inflate tyres up to 120psi and fully charges in under an hour. It fits both Presta and Schrader valves, you can preset inflation pressure so it cuts off automatically, and the Air Rush also doubles as a digital pressure gauge.

Garmin Rally RS210 dual-sided power meter pedals

£682 | sigmasports.com

If you’ve got a road bike and a gravel bike and you like to keep track of your power numbers, your options are either to get two power meters or get one set of Garmin Rally RS210 dual-sided power meter pedals. They measure left and right power, allowing you to monitor your souplesse, and they’re accurate to ±1% while having a battery life of up to 90 hours. But best of all, the internals can be swapped between Shimano-compatible road and off-road pedals, making it easy to swap bikes but keep watching the watts.

Rule 28 OTNR long-sleeve aero jersey

£165 | rule28.com

Winter miles don’t have to be slow. Rule 28’s OTNR long-sleeve aero jersey uses Superspeed fabric, which reduces drag while adding thermal properties and PFC-free DWR M water-repellent treatment. It also uses Thermoroubaix winter fabric, which has the same treatment. As well as being fast, the OTNR is comfortable to wear thanks to clean seams and a refined fit to prevent irritation, plus it has three standard rear pockets and a waterproof valuables pocket.

The Model Cyclist 

£32.50 | themodelcyclist.com

Recreate the cyclist in your life – or even yourself – in miniature. The Model Cyclist will custom-paint 1/32 scale die-cast zinc alloy models from your reference pictures to create as accurate a portrait as possible. You choose the style, design and colour from jerseys to socks, bike frames to hairstyles, even beards and tattoos. The models are hand-painted in Yorkshire, and at 50mm are small enough for a mantelpiece while still being packed full of character. There’s also a pre-painted range of cyclists in famous jerseys such as the World Championship rainbow bands or maillot jaune from the Tour de France. 

Inferno Series

From £2,125 | infernoseries.com

Each Inferno Series event takes on some of Europe’s best, most demanding road riding over three to five stages. There are four events to choose from – French Gorges, French Alps, Pyrenees, and Dolomites and Slovenia – and up to 80 riders can participate in each. Stages are long and challenging (an average stage is 150km-plus with around 5,000m of climbing), but support from the Inferno Series team is first class – they take care of everything from feed stops and massages to transfers and luggage. The events run from May to October 2027, while there’s a training camp option in February to help riders prep for their chosen event.

Rocker Feet for turbos

£29.99-£75.99 | therockerfeetco.com

Turbo trainer season is coming, and these cunning Rocker Feet adapters can upgrade your trainer setup to make it move more naturally beneath you. They work by holding tennis balls (not included) that bring a bit of movement to your indoor rides, making it feel more like riding outdoors and helping to reduce saddle fatigue. Solidly built using 3D printing, there are Rocker Feet to match pretty much every turbo trainer out there, including Wahoo Kickr, Wattbike, Zwift Hub, Elite, JetBlack, Van Rysel and Peloton. 

Bryton Rider S810 bike computer

£249.99 | extrauk.co.uk

The Bryton Rider S810 has a bright, 3.5in colour touchscreen and all the features you expect from a modern bike computer: pre-loaded maps, turn-by-turn navigation, advanced re-routing, training plan support, Strava Live Segment integration, voice search… the list goes on. But perhaps its biggest draw is battery life – up to 50 hours of use between charges, with advanced power management features to optimise energy use, and all at a a price that undercuts many similarly specced rivals.

Trek RSL Road Cycling shoes

£349.99 | trekbikes.com

They say you can tell someone’s personality from their shoes, so what would Trek’s RSL Road shoes say about you? First, that you take your riding very seriously, hence the super-stiff carbon footplate and supple, lightweight uppers. But more than that, the RSLs say you understand that the efficiency and performance of a cycling shoe lies in its fit, hence the Trek RSLs being modelled on a wider, more-comfortable-for-most last, secured with a choice of laces or dual Boa dials and utilising an external heel cup to prevent feet slipping.

Moon Sport Metis light

£79.99 | extrauk.co.uk

Combining a bike light and computer mount is just a bright idea, especially when that light is a dual high-beam LED with powerful 1,000-lumen output. You can choose from six preset brightness settings, with the lowest offering up to 170 hours of battery life, while the computer mount fits head units from Garmin, Wahoo or Bryton. The Metis is IPX6-rated waterproof, incorporates a bell and an 80dB alarm, and can be operated using a handlebar-mounted wireless remote control so you don’t have to take your hands off the bars.

Ravemen FR1500 front light

£104.95 | ravemen.com

More Boxing Day leftovers, more lumens, and more battery life… yes please. For riders wanting more, the new Ravemen FR1500 has a 1,500-lumen light with the beam reaching up to 115m. The battery life is up to an impressive 60 hours, and it can also double as a power bank in case of emergency. There’s an eye-catching warning flashing mode to keep you visible during daytime too. The FR1500 has IPX6 water resistance, so there’s no excuse to get those miles in whether its rain or shine. As well as that, the top is designed to connect a Garmin-style bike computer so you can use one mount for both.    

Ravemen FR1000 front light

£84.95 | ravemen.com

If your loved one doesn’t have bike lights, get them the Ravemen FR1000 front light. If your loved one does have bike lights, get them the Ravemen FR1000 front light. The 1,000-lumen light keeps you visible day and night, while it has an auto on/off function that switches the light off after two minutes of inactivity. Battery life is up to 39 hours, it can double as a power bank in case of emergency, and it features a detachable GoPro-style bottom mount for attaching a camera or other accessories. As well as that, the top is designed to connect a Garmin-style bike computer so you can use one mount for both.

Pactimo Men’s Alpine thermal bibtights

£156 | pactimo.com

It gets pretty chilly in the high mountains of Colorado where Pactimo is based. That’s why the company has produced bibtights that can cope with the coldest days. The Italian-milled, recycled nylon fleece fabric is soft on skin and provides plenty of warmth without bulk while maintaining breathability. The four-way stretch material ensures a perfect fit, and an Elastic Interface pad keeps you comfortable. A zipped side pocket and reflective detailing add the finishing touches.

Ravemen CL200 Bike Tail Light

£54.95 | ravemen.com

If the Ravemen FR1000 front light (above) is already in the stocking, why not complete the set with the Ravemen CL200 Bike Tail Light? It tucks away under your saddle for a clean, streamlined look and weighs just 31g, yet delivers a 200-lumen, 300° wide-angle beam to ensure you’re clearly visible from multiple directions. It offers up to 160 hours of runtime per charge and has a smart brake detection feature that shines the light brighter for two seconds when you press the brakes to let drivers behind know you’re slowing down.

Veto 1.0 Crew socks

£20 | vetosocks.com

Veto’s 1.0 Crew socks are a wolf in sheep’s clothing. On the surface they’re a comfortable, knitted cycling sock built from a lightly compressive polyamide and elastane blend, with a ribbed cuff that keeps them in place and seam-free toes to minimise chafing. The hidden bite comes in the wind-tunnel, where the brand’s testing shows they perform as well as or better than some aero-optimised competitors. Free speed without giving up comfort – in whichever of the 25-plus colourways suits your kit.

Madison Flux HydroShift jacket

£199.99 | madison.cc

If you’re braving the elements this winter, you can rest easy in the knowledge that protective cycling kit has never been better. Madison’s new Flux HydroShift packable jacket uses a PU membrane containing microscopic pores sized specifically to let vapour from sweat out but prevent rain and wind from getting in. As a result it carries a 10,000mm waterproof rating (ie, it’ll definitely keep you dry) despite being lightweight and packable enough to fit into a jersey pocket.

Wattbike Atom indoor smart bike

£2,499 | wattbike.com

Why not start the New Year off by fitting out your pain cave with Wattbike’s Atom indoor smart bike? Its electromagnetic flywheel has been tuned to replicate real-world pedalling feel and power readings are accurate to ±1% up to 2,500W. The Atom offers virtual gearing and a responsive Erg mode, and is compatible with all major training software. Wattbike also has its own subscription-free Hub app platform that can be used to structure training and analyse your pedalling technique. 

Scott Blade sunglasses

£101.99 | scott-sports.com

These sleek Scott Blade sunglasses are designed to provide an optimal field of vision on the bike. They combine a semi-frameless design with Scott’s Amplifier Lens technology that enhances contrast and clarity by filtering light wavelengths, while the 100% UV protection helps shield eyes from harmful UVA and UVB rays. At just 31g, they’re lightweight too. The no-slip nose pads and temple ends keep them comfortably in place, and the Blades are available with interchangeable lenses ranging from green to red chrome and even purple. 

Liv Tesca Pro gravel shoes

£324.99 | liv-cycling.com

Liv is among the most prominent manufacturers of cycling kit specifically for women, which is why its Tesca Pro shoes use a women-specific last that’s based on extensive 3D scans of women’s feet. This has resulted in a larger toe box and a wider overall shape – dialled in with Boa’s premium Li2 dials – to keep feet stable and comfortable. A full carbon plate maximises power transfer without creating an uncomfortable walking platform – perfect for off-road or cyclocross use.

Giant Surge Pro cycling shoes

£324.99 | giant-bicycles.com

With help from Jayco AlUla pro Michael Matthews, the Giant Surge Pro shoes have been designed to cope with the rigours of WorldTour racing. That means an ultra-stiff carbon plate, tuneable arch support and sizing options that cover riders with both slimmer or wider feet. The upper material is a woven mesh wrapped in a TPU skin that’s breathable but reinforced for year-round versatility, while the additional fourth bolt on the sole means the Surge Pros are compatible with a wider range of pedal systems.

4Endurance 2:1 Bundle

£19.99 | 4endurance.co.uk

Nutrition products are always a safe bet as a gift for cyclists at Christmas, especially when it’s 4Endurance’s 2:1 Bundle we’re talking about. The company’s products are designed specifically for use by endurance athletes, with the 2:1 name referring to the ratio of glucose to fructose carbohydrates. The bundle includes ten 2:1 Bars, ten 2:1 Gels and a 30-serving pack of 2:1 Drink, giving you a choice of fuelling options to suit different situations on the bike, with several flavour options available for each that are formulated using only high-quality ingredients. 

Marmot Tours gift voucher

marmot-tours.co.uk

Got enough cycling stuff? Then how about a gift voucher towards a cycling holiday instead? The team at Marmot Tours has been helping groups, couples and solo cyclists conquer Tour de France classics in France, Vuelta a España favourites in Spain, or epic Giro d’Italia passes in Italy, Switzerland, Slovenia and Austria for over 20 years. Several formats can be chosen from, including flexi-pace tours with daily route options, or raids and set challenges. Each tour is accompanied by two ride guides and a kitted-out van, so every rider has the support worthy of a WorldTour pro. Vouchers are available in an amount of your choice.

L’Étape Cycliste Signature Urban cycling shorts

£249 | letapecycliste.com

Not every ride calls for full cycling kit. Whether it’s a relaxed weekend spin, a coffee stop, a ride across the city or the daily commute, cyclists still want proper on-bike comfort without looking dressed for a race. L’Étape Cycliste’s Signature Urban Cycling Shorts combine the best of both worlds. A premium, athletic-cut outer shell delivers the understated appearance of everyday shorts, while a fully integrated, professional-grade cycling liner featuring an Elastic Interface chamois provides the comfort and performance serious cyclists expect.

Gtechniq maintenance kits

£55.95 and £24.95 | gtechniq.co.uk

Everyone loves a clean bike, and Gtechniq’s range of maintenance kits makes the job easy. The Bike Clean spray breaks down grime when sprayed onto a filthy bike and left to work. Then, when the bike is rinsed off and dried, it’s time for the Ceramic Quick Coat. This clever solution gives the frame and components a hydrophobic layer that makes it harder for dirt to attach and makes cleaning even easier. The Essential Care Kit comes with everything you’ll need for a full clean, including degreaser, a microfibre cloth and detailing brush.

Garmin Forerunner 970 GPS watch

£598 | sigmasports.com

The Forerunner 970 is not so much a watch as a wrist-based navigation, training, performance-monitoring, communication and entertainment device. The bright AMOLED screen is touch-sensitive yet tough as old boots, while the titanium bezel is strong and lightweight – the whole watch weighs just 47g. You can track rides, follow routes, get training plans, crunch data, monitor sleep, check heart rate variability, read emails, listen to music and even tell the time. In fact there isn’t much the Forerunner 970 can’t do.

Condor Essentials Toe Covers

£14.99 | condorcycles.com

Sometimes you don’t need it all. Semi-skimmed milk, one finger of a KitKat, just the first season of The Wire. And so it goes with overshoes, because even in autumn and winter, just toe covers – or tovershoes as we like to call them – can be enough. Enter stage left: Condor’s Essentials Toe Covers, which feature a fleece-backed lining and PU outer to keep your most southerly of extremities warm, all while keeping your shoes cleaner and your rides safer – that Condor logo isn’t just pretty, it’s also highly reflective. 

Apidura Packable Musette

£34 | apidura.com

We didn’t invent musettes – they evolved out of feedbags for French horses as a place to stow fun-sized Cokes and energy gels – but we cyclists love them as if we did, and Apidura’s Packable Musette is a great example. At seven litres it’s classic musette roomy, but added to that is a Velcro closure and adjustable crossbody strap to prevent it sliding as you ride. It’s also made from super-light ripstop Cordura fabric, so it’s water resistant and packs down small enough to fit in a jersey pocket, or can attach to your bike via an integrated strap.
